{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Main where

import Web.Scotty
import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Lazy as TL
import Text.Regex.TDFA ((=~))
import Text.Regex.TDFA.Text ()
import Data.IORef
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Control.Monad.IO.Class (liftIO)
import Network.HTTP.Types.Status (status403, status200, status400)
import System.Timeout (timeout)

-- Multi-tenant configuration store
type TenantId = Text
data TenantConfig = TenantConfig
  { tenantName :: Text
  , allowedEmailPattern :: Text  -- Regex for allowed email domains
  , maxUsers :: Int
  } deriving (Show)

type TenantStore = IORef (Map.Map TenantId TenantConfig)

-- Default tenant configurations with email validation patterns
defaultTenants :: Map.Map TenantId TenantConfig
defaultTenants = Map.fromList
  [ ("tenant-alpha", TenantConfig "Alpha Corp" "^[a-zA-Z0-9.]+@alpha\\.com$" 100)
  , ("tenant-beta", TenantConfig "Beta Inc" "^[a-zA-Z0-9.]+@beta\\.org$" 50)
  ]

-- Allowed regex metacharacters (restrictive whitelist)
isAllowedPatternChar :: Char -> Bool
isAllowedPatternChar c = c `elem` ("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789.@^$\\-" :: String)

-- Validate that a pattern is safe (no quantifiers that could cause backtracking)
validatePatternSafety :: Text -> Bool
validatePatternSafety pat =
  let hasNestedQuantifiers = T.isInfixOf "+*" pat || T.isInfixOf "*+" pat ||
                             T.isInfixOf "++" pat || T.isInfixOf "**" pat
      hasGroupedQuantifiers = T.isInfixOf ")+" pat || T.isInfixOf ")*" pat
      allCharsAllowed = T.all isAllowedPatternChar (T.filter (/= '+') pat)
      maxLen = T.length pat <= 100
  in not hasNestedQuantifiers && not hasGroupedQuantifiers && allCharsAllowed && maxLen

-- Normalize the pattern for consistent matching across tenants
normalizePattern :: Text -> Text
normalizePattern pat =
  let stripped = T.strip pat
      anchored = if T.isPrefixOf "^" stripped then stripped
                 else T.append "^" stripped
      final = if T.isSuffixOf "$" anchored then anchored
              else T.append anchored "$"
  in final

-- Build composite pattern for tenant email validation
-- Only uses pre-validated base patterns, does NOT accept arbitrary user input
buildValidationRegex :: TenantConfig -> Text
buildValidationRegex config = normalizePattern (allowedEmailPattern config)

-- Validate email against tenant's configured pattern with timeout protection
validateEmail :: Text -> Text -> IO Bool
validateEmail email pattern_ = do
  let normalizedPattern = normalizePattern pattern_
  result <- timeout 1000000 $ do  -- 1 second timeout
    let matched = (email :: Text) =~ (normalizedPattern :: Text) :: Bool
    matched `seq` return matched
  return $ maybe False id result

-- Check if user input matches the tenant's security policy
checkTenantAccess :: TenantStore -> TenantId -> Text -> IO Bool
checkTenantAccess store tid email = do
  tenants <- readIORef store
  case Map.lookup tid tenants of
    Nothing -> return False
    Just config -> do
      let fullPattern = buildValidationRegex config
      validateEmail email fullPattern

-- Register a new custom domain pattern for a tenant (admin only, validated)
registerDomainPattern :: TenantStore -> TenantId -> Text -> IO (Either Text ())
registerDomainPattern store tid newPattern = do
  tenants <- readIORef store
  case Map.lookup tid tenants of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Tenant not found"
    Just config -> do
      if not (T.isInfixOf "@" newPattern)
        then return $ Left "Pattern must be an email pattern (contain @)"
        else if not (validatePatternSafety newPattern)
          then return $ Left "Pattern contains unsafe regex constructs"
          else do
            -- Store only the new pattern as a simple literal domain match
            let safeLiteral = T.concat ["^[a-zA-Z0-9.]+", newPattern, "$"]
            let updated = config { allowedEmailPattern = safeLiteral }
            modifyIORef store (Map.insert tid updated)
            return $ Right ()

-- Sanitize input to prevent obvious injection
sanitizeInput :: Text -> Text
sanitizeInput = T.filter (\c -> c /= '\0' && c /= '\n' && c /= '\r')

-- Validate email format before regex matching
isValidEmailFormat :: Text -> Bool
isValidEmailFormat email =
  let parts = T.splitOn "@" email
      validLength = T.length email <= 254
      hasSingleAt = length parts == 2
      localPart = if hasSingleAt then head parts else ""
      domainPart = if hasSingleAt then parts !! 1 else ""
      localValid = T.length localPart > 0 && T.length localPart <= 64
      domainValid = T.length domainPart > 0 && T.length domainPart <= 253
  in validLength && hasSingleAt && localValid && domainValid

main :: IO ()
main = do
  store <- newIORef defaultTenants
  scotty 3000 $ do

    -- Endpoint: validate a user's email for tenant access
    post "/api/v1/tenant/:tid/validate" $ do
      tid <- param "tid"
      emailRaw <- param "email"
      let email = sanitizeInput (TL.toStrict emailRaw)
      if not (isValidEmailFormat email)
        then do
          status status400
          json (Map.fromList [("error" :: Text, "Invalid email format" :: Text)])
        else do
          result <- liftIO $ checkTenantAccess store (TL.toStrict tid) email
          if result
            then do
              status status200
              json (Map.fromList [("access" :: Text, "granted" :: Text)])
            else do
              status status403
              json (Map.fromList [("access" :: Text, "denied" :: Text)])

    -- Endpoint: register additional email domain pattern (validated)
    post "/api/v1/tenant/:tid/patterns" $ do
      tid <- param "tid"
      patternRaw <- param "pattern"
      let pat = sanitizeInput (TL.toStrict patternRaw)
      result <- liftIO $ registerDomainPattern store (TL.toStrict tid) pat
      case result of
        Left err -> do
          status status400
          json (Map.fromList [("error" :: Text, err)])
        Right () -> do
          status status200
          json (Map.fromList [("status" :: Text, "registered" :: Text)])

    -- Endpoint: health check
    get "/health" $ do
      status status200
      text "OK"
